messages.subject: Package from github private repository
parts: Is it possible to have a pacakge running from a github private repository on shinyapps.io?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Package from github private repository
parts:
John,

That is not currently supported at the moment. While its possible to install from a private repo using devtools, we don't support this with ShinyApps. If this is a feature that many people are ask for, we may be able to see about finding a way to make this work.

-Andy
